夜番を除く皆が寝静まっている時間に、\nふと目が覚めた。: I woke up unexpectedly during a time when everyone except those on night watch was fast asleep.
身体の訴えに従い、テントを出て仮設トイレで用を足し、\nテントに戻ろうとしている: Answering nature's call, I left my tent to use the temporary restroom, and as I was heading back... I spotted a shadow.
（――あれはラミか？ こんな時間にどこへ……）: (—Is that Rami? Where is she going at this hour...?)
そっと後を追うと、\n彼女は臨時拠点からそう離れていない浜辺に出た。: Quietly following behind her, I found that she had walked out onto the beach not far from our temporary base.
――波打ち際、切なく白い明かりに照らされるラミ。\nえらく絵になってるじゃないか: —Standing at the water's edge, lit by a mournful white light. It really looks like a picture, doesn't it?
っていうか、そ、そう？ 絵になってる？\n珍しいじゃん、おまえが素直にラミを褒め: I mean, i-is that so? Like a picture? It's pretty rare for you to compliment Rami so directly like that—
それは絵じゃなくて落書きだろ！\nラミみたいな美少女捕まえて落書き扱いっておまえ: That's not a picture, that's a doodle! Treating a beautiful girl like Rami like a doodle, are you in your right mind!?
はぁ！？ なに笑ってんだよ！\nていうか指揮官なんだから寝とけよ！: Hah!? What are you laughing at! Besides, you're the commander, go to sleep already!
それはこっちの台詞だ。\nお前こそこんな時間に何してんだ、いい子は寝る時間だろ。: That's my line. What are you doing up at this hour anyway? It's bedtime for good kids.
……別に、なんか目が覚めちゃったから、風に当たりに来ただけだし。: ...It's nothing. I just woke up for some reason, so I came out to get some fresh air.
うん。なんか文句ある？: Yeah. Do you have a problem with that?
文句なら――ある！: If it's complaints you're asking for—I've got one!
わ、わわわっ！？\nおい！ 急に何すんの、髪ぐっちゃぐちゃになるじゃんか！: W-Waah!? Hey! What are you doing all of a sudden, my hair's gonna get totally messed up!
辛気臭い顔をしてるお前が悪い！\nついでに、撫でやすい頭をしてるのも悪い！: It's your fault for making such a gloomy face! And while we're at it, it's also your fault for having such a head that's so easy to pat!
理不尽すぎるだろ！\n理由ふたつもあってどっちも理不尽！: That's way too unreasonable! Two reasons and both of them are absurd!
いやあ、本当に撫でやすい頭だなぁ！\nずっとこうしていたいぜ……: Man, this head really is so easy to pat! I could just stay like this forever...
それ膝枕とかで言うやつ！\n本当にずっと撫でてたら、おまえの腕がおかしくなるから: That's a line you say when giving a lap pillow! If you really keep patting me forever, your arm's gonna give out!
っていうか本当に何！？ 何なの！？: I mean, seriously, what is it!? What's going on!?
か、可愛い？ ふふん、おまえもやっと素直になったか――: C-Cute? Fufun, so you've finally decided to be honest—
いや可愛いから出る行動がこれなのはやっぱおかしいでしょ！: Wait, calling me cute and then doing this is still completely weird!
え？ おまえ何言って――あっ、もしかして、\n可愛いものを攻撃したくなるっていう: Huh? What are you talking about—Ah, don't tell me it's that thing where people want to attack cute things?
ふふん、それならそうと言えよー。\n……本気でラミを壊そうとしてるわけじゃないよ: Fufun, just say so if that's it～ ...You're not seriously trying to break Rami, right? Right?
で、そういうおふざけはもういいから！\n結局どうしたの？ なんかあったわけ？: Anyway, enough with the messing around! What is it really? Did something happen?
だーかーら、それはこっちの台詞だ。\nこんな時間に、海辺で一人物思いにふけるなん: Li～ke I said, that's my line. Lost in thought alone by the sea at this hour isn't like you.
何か引っかかってることがあるなら、サンドバッグになってやるぞ。\nラミいわく、俺: If something's bothering you, I can be your punching bag. According to Rami, I'm a priceless presence no matter what she says to me.
言っただろうが！ こんにゃろ！: You definitely did, you little devil!
ぎゃー！ わしゃわしゃ強くすんなー！: Gyaaah! Don't mess with my hair so hard～!
あーもう！ 離れろ！\n話すにしたって、このまま話せるわけないでしょ！: Ah, geez! Let go! Even if I want to talk, I can't talk like this!
おっ、話す気になってくれたか。: Oho, so you're willing to talk now.
おまえがあんまりにもしつこいからな。\n……まあ、簡単に言えば、まだ戸惑ってるっ: Only because you're being so ridiculously persistent. ...Well, simply put, I'm just still a bit bewildered.
最初は、双頭の斧の一斉検挙だったのに。\n身体の自由を奪われたり、取り戻したり…: At first, it was just supposed to be a roundup of Twin-Headed Axe. Then having my body's freedom stolen, getting it back...
不参加って聞いてたクラスナがおまえと一緒にいて、\nなんか双頭の斧のボスも味方に: Krasna, who I heard wasn't participating, is with you, and somehow even the boss of Twin-Headed Axe turned into an ally...
これでちゃんと状況を理解して、\nついていけって言うほうが無理じゃん。: Expecting me to properly understand the situation and keep up with all this is just asking for the impossible.
まあ、確かにそうだよな。俺も最初は混乱したよ。\nでもなんとか、こうして最後の決: Well, that's true. I was confused at first too. But somehow, we've managed to push things all the way to the eve of the final battle.
次の戦いで全部決まる。文字通りの最終決戦だ。\n……やっぱり不安か？: Everything will be decided in the next battle. It's literally the final battle. ...Are you anxious after all?
ん～……別に。\n戸惑ってはいるけど、特に不安はないかな。: Nn～ ...Not really. I'm bewildered, but I wouldn't say I'm particularly anxious.
だって、おまえがラミ達を日常に返してくれるんでしょ？: Because you're going to bring Rami and the others back to our everyday lives, right?
だから不安なんてない。\nラミは、おまえの言うことなら信じてやる。: So I'm not anxious. Rami will believe whatever you say.
……ありがとな、信じてくれて。\n必ず、お前たちが学園生活に戻れるようにしてみせ: ...Thanks for believing in me. I'll make sure all of you can return to your school lives.
トーゼンでしょ！\n……あーでも、不安はないんだけど、心配はあるかも。: Of course you will! ...Ah, but while I'm not anxious, I might have a worry.
心配？ ならそれも話してくれ。\n指揮官として、そういうのを解消するのも務めだか: A worry? Tell me about that too, then. As commander, resolving those things is part of my job.
……ラミが心配してんのは、おまえのことだよ。: ...What Rami is worried about is you.
だからさ――ちょっと待って。\nよし……これ持ってて。: I mean—wait a second. Alright... keep this with you.
これって、いつも着けてる髪飾り……: Isn't this the hair ornament you always wear...?
おまえのМＧって、本当は探索用じゃん。\n最近戦えるようになったって言っても、現: Your MG is actually an exploration model, right? Even if it's become capable of fighting recently, it's just been modified on the spot, hasn't it?
なのにいっつも、いっつもいっつも一番前に飛び出して。\nだから、お守り。: And yet you always, always, always jump out to the very front. So, it's a good luck charm.
昔のアマツには、お守りとして簪を贈る風習があったんだって。\nでも簪はないから…: I heard that long ago in Amatsu, there was a custom of gifting hairpin ornaments as a protective charm. But I don't have a hairpin... so keep that.
解けた髪を風になびかせながら、\nラミが優しく微笑む。: With her untied hair fluttering in the wind, Rami smiled gently.
本当は男が女に『お前を守る』って意味で贈るから、逆なんだけどさ。\nま～、そもそ: Normally, a man gives it to a woman to mean 'I'll protect you,' so it's backwards, though. Well～ you're the one being protected to begin with anyway.
……俺だって、お前達を守りたいんだが。: ...I want to protect all of you too, you know.
今までのＭＧ戦の時に守られ続けてたへなちょこは誰だっけ～？: Who was the weakling who kept getting protected during the MG battles so far, I wonder～?
ぐっ……それを言われると反論できん……！: Guh... Put that way, I can't even argue back...!
……だから、戦いが終わった後に、それ返しに来て。\n返さなかったら、許さないから: ...So, after the battle is over, come return that to me. If you don't return it, I won't forgive you.
（そうか、これはラミにとって、\n願いを託した『お守り』なのか……）: (I see, to Rami, this is a 'good luck charm' entrusted with her wishes...)
……ああ、分かった。必ずこの手で、お前に返すよ。: ...Yeah, I got it. I'll definitely return it to you with my own hands.
朧げな月明かりに照らし出されるラミの顔は、\nいつになくきれいだった。: Illuminated by the hazy moonlight, Rami's face looked more beautiful than ever before.
――にしても、まさかラミからプロポーズされるなんてな。\n簪の代わりってそういう: —Still, I never expected to get a proposal from Rami. Giving an alternative to a hairpin means that, right?
な……っ！？ ぼ、ぼかしたのに知ってんの！？\nそれは話が違うじゃん……！ いや: Wh...! Y-You knew even though I kept it vague!? That's totally different from what I expected...! Wait, it wasn't a proposal anyway!
それぐらい分かってるっつーの。\n大体、いつまで俺のことを座学苦手なアホだと思っ: I knew that much, you know. Honestly, how long are you going to keep treating me like a dunce who's bad at studying?
……ふん。じゃ、一個お願いしてもいい？: ...Hmph. Well then, can I ask you one favor?
ラミはまた別の、そしてそっくりな見た目の髪飾りを取り出す。: Rami pulled out another hair ornament that looked almost identical.
これ予備のやつ。これで髪を結んでくれない？\nあ、変な風に結んだらマジ怒るから。: This is a spare. Could you tie my hair with this? Ah, if you tie it strangely, I'll be seriously mad.
いいから……おまえに結んでほしいの。: Just do it... I want you to tie it.
それきり黙ってしまったラミの髪に、そっと触れる。: Touching the hair of Rami, who fell completely silent after saying that, I gently reached out.
見よう見まねに近いレベルだったが……\n慎重に、なんとか、髪飾りをいつもの位置に: It was almost just mimicking what I'd seen before, but... carefully, somehow, I managed to tie the hair ornament in its usual place.
……ねえ、イザナミなんかさっさとぶっ飛ばしてさ。\n一緒に学園に帰ろ。: ...Hey, let's blow away Izanami already and go back to the academy together.
ああ、そうだな……必ず、一緒に帰ろう。: Yeah, that's right... Let's definitely go back together.
約束だかんね。まだ頭追いついてないことも多いけど、\nこの約束だけは、絶対に破ん: It's a promise, okay? My mind still hasn't caught up with everything, but don't you dare break this promise.
俺は静かに、そして力強く頷いた――\nラミとの約束は、絶対に破ってはならないもの: I gave a quiet, firm nod— because I felt that the promise with Rami was something that must never be broken.
まっ、おまえみたいなザコ系男子と一緒に帰ってあげるのなんか、\nラミぐらいしかい: Well, Rami's the only one who would accompany a small-fry guy like you back home anyway. I kind of wish you'd weep with gratitude.
俺達は砂浜に足跡を残しながら、ふたりでゆっくりと、\n皆のいる場所へと帰るのだっ: Leaving footprints behind in the sand, the two of us slowly walked back toward where everyone else was.
